# Make sure OSS-Fuzz's CXXFLAGS are propagated into the build
sed -i 's/CXXFLAGS =/#CXXFLAGS/g' Makefile

make -j$(nproc) clean
make -j$(nproc) all

fuzz_harness=$(ls -d "$SRC"/*.cpp)
for h in $fuzz_harness; do
  $CXX $CXXFLAGS -std=c++11 -Iinclude/ "$h" \
    -o "$OUT/$(basename "$h" .cpp)" $LIB_FUZZING_ENGINE $SRC/tinyxml2/libtinyxml2.a
done

all: xmltest staticlib

rebuild: clean all

xmltest: xmltest.cpp libtinyxml2.a
dependency_reason: The all target includes the library build.

    	Returns XML_SUCCESS (0) on success, or
    	an errorID.

    	You may optionally pass in the 'nBytes', which is
    	the number of bytes which will be parsed. If not
    	specified, TinyXML-2 will assume 'xml' points to a
    	null terminated string.
    */
    XMLError Parse( const char* xml, size_t nBytes=static_cast<size_t>(-1) );

Parse handles empty input and uses strlen for the default length.
Parse clears state and cleans up after errors.
Clear deletes children and the character buffer.

The public Parse call prepares the buffer, invokes the private parser, and handles errors.
The private parser applies the initial guards and calls ParseDeep.
